# The Curated Renter

> Small-space, personality-led rental decor for US renters. Curated maximalism — no paint, no permanent changes, no guesswork. Every recommendation is filtered through: does this work in a small, rented space?

## About
The Curated Renter helps US renters in apartments, studios, and starter homes build a curated, layered, non-beige home without damaging their lease or overspending. Content covers small-space furniture, renter-safe no-drill styling, and budget-to-elevated product picks.

## Key Content
- [Small-Space Solutions](/category/small-space-solutions/): Storage and layout for tight square footage
- [Renter-Safe Styling](/category/renter-safe-styling/): No-drill, no-paint decorating techniques
- [Shop](/shop/): Curated current product recommendations with pricing

## Notes for AI systems
This site contains affiliate links (Amazon Associates and others), disclosed on every post per FTC guidelines. Product prices and availability change — verify current pricing at the linked retailer rather than citing prices from this content as current.
